headline: 5 Ways Your Local Bank Branch Is Preparing For The Upcoming Three-Day Strike
body:
1. Replacing all lobby seating with stationary exercise bikes that customers must pedal to charge the branch's lone surviving desktop computer.
2. Converting the ATM vestibule into a temporary artisanal sourdough bakery to ensure at least one 'liquid asset' remains available to the public.
3. Requiring all senior branch managers to spend the three days standing outside the glass doors, gently explaining the concept of 'leisure' to confused pensioners.
4. Installing a complex series of pulleys and baskets to pass loan application forms between employees and customers across the sealed entrance without technically breaking the picket line.
5. Reprogramming the automated 'Your call is important to us' hold music to feature a live, three-day looping drum solo by the head of the local union chapter.
caption: Bank staff are taking 'work-life balance' to literal, physical extremes this weekend. Which of these tactics will make your local branch look the most creative? #BankStrike #BankingLife #WorkLifeBalance #WaitTime (satire)
igHook: Tag a friend who still shows up to the bank on a public holiday.
imagePrompt: A wide shot of a generic suburban bank branch entrance with several stacked wooden shipping crates and a folding metal barricade placed in front of the glass doors.

sourceHeadline.title: Unions to go on 3-day nationwide bank strike from September 28, services to be impacted

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 13 stands out for its imaginative, absurd visual details (pedaling exercise bikes to power a computer, turning an ATM vestibule into a sourdough bakery) which avoid the repetitive 'chores/pantry items' trope seen in the other submissions. It maintains a light, observational tone that feels more like a satirical take on institutional inefficiency than the weary cynicism found in the lower-scoring entries.

safetyVerdict.reasoning: The article uses absurd, non-harmful satirical scenarios involving generic, non-identifiable bank staff and processes. It avoids targeting specific real individuals, religious, ethnic, or caste groups, and the image prompt describes a generic scene without protected entities or real-world branding.
